name: marketing-11
title: Studio landing page with shapes made of points
description: A Lisanga Studio page where one canvas of points breaks apart and rebuilds a planet with a ring, a phone, a laptop, a monitor, a globe, a network and a dial as each section reaches the middle of the window, with an editorial header, a rail of dots that jumps to the sections and a full footer.
